Phase-4.NAME: RtkShellIntegration
Phase-4.purpose: Integrate RTK as the token-optimized shell policy and telemetry layer.

steps.step-1: Detect RTK availability and version in doctor and dashboard health.
steps.step-2: Rewrite eligible shell commands through RTK after approval policy resolution.
steps.step-3: Preserve raw passthrough and exact exit-code behavior.
steps.step-4: Expose RTK savings summary in observability views.
